plan_name: Design Repricing-Focused Public Evidence Collection Plan v1

recommended_collection_strategy.collection_after_successor: Independent 12-hour public-only repricing-focused sessions, BTC/ETH/SOL, full market lifecycle, strict continuity and replay gates, no canonical merge.
recommended_collection_strategy.immediate_successor: Run Repricing Threshold Sensitivity Audit v1
recommended_collection_strategy.moderate_plan: Target 22 independent 12-hour sessions or until 300 signals, >=75 per asset, and >=100 per side all pass.
recommended_collection_strategy.strong_plan: Target 77 independent 12-hour sessions or until 1000 signals, >=250 per asset, and >=350 per side all pass.
recommended_collection_strategy.weak_plan: Target 8 independent 12-hour sessions or until 100 signals, >=25 per asset, and >=35 per side all pass.
recommended_collection_strategy.why: Freeze density and balance-oriented entry thresholds from existing public sessions before spending new capture time.

strategy_signal_rate_estimates.description: Current replay rules: qualified lag or confidence-below-threshold only; non-overlapping paper positions per market/side.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.main_risk: Slow accumulation and severe YES/BTC underrepresentation.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.recommended_use: Baseline evidence lane; keep unchanged for continuity.

strategy_signal_rate_estimates.description: Capture all BTC/ETH/SOL five-minute markets from open through expiry with the same public schema and fixed replay rules.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.main_risk: Still may be side-imbalanced if market drift is one-sided.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.recommended_use: Preferred evidence collection lane after threshold audit.

strategy_signal_rate_estimates.description: Before any new capture, replay existing sessions under fixed lag-score and confidence alternatives, then freeze one relaxed threshold stratum.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.main_risk: Overfitting if thresholds are selected on P&L rather than signal density and balance.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.recommended_use: Immediate successor task; do not claim edge from threshold selection.

strategy_signal_rate_estimates.description: Separate 30s/60s/120s repricing stratum for events currently rejected as near-expiry-insufficient-time; no final-resolution holding.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.main_risk: Expiry effects, censorship, and execution risk differ from baseline repricing.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.recommended_use: Pilot only after explicit gates; never mix untagged with baseline.

strategy_signal_rate_estimates.description: Include public BTC/ETH/SOL markets with longer expiry horizons, if available, while preserving per-horizon stratification.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.main_risk: Market mechanics may differ from five-minute crypto contracts.
strategy_signal_rate_estimates.recommended_use: Secondary expansion path once baseline collection is healthy.
